dependency_contracts.meaning: Dominance ranks priority, number, source time/index, first-equal original input tie. Activation/stop endpoints inclusive. Per-main stop chooses higher rank incl event time. Accepted A excludes invalid source pair; S/E stop delegated, StopAll retained event. Same-source anchors use priority/number/type tie; later source independent. Reset uses precise second time when available else strict lower crossing of half-open main candle; no fabricated fallback.

Sorted tuple identity carries physical and reset pairs, stop/source/anchor provenance and Decimal boundary, not only count. Feedback up to eight, identical identity registers legs, repeated prior identity or exhaustion raises. Register by physical pair, create stop fields only on missing entry, append distinct cause and sort by exact event/reset/strict/physical identity; invalidate carried caches.

Accepted A filter keeps first accepted creating cause plus complete accepted causes; unchanged entry reused when all equal. Prepared audit merges S then E by pair; include in-range First or required identity, merge causes; stop_cross absent invokes detector, present null stays null. Exact parent-stop key assigned earliest confirmation/First/Break rank; preserve other causes. Bridge validates public physical identities and unique cause owner; restoration rebuild preserves previously canonical identities.

Native opposite matches sorted by confirmation, First, Break, ordinal. Optional independent geometry must start at/after gate index and confirm strictly after A stop, map exact physical identity to existing ordinal else zero. Compare independent/native by First then confirmation, strict earlier wins; no invented public Reaction. Bridge chooses live/native finder or configured callable; selected engine paths remain conditional.

limitations: Historical local W1 interpretations carried forward by identical source, all seven canonical categories identity-checked; additional categories structural only. Full W2 and W3 remain open.
